claimBoundary: No Round 9 task was sent to Vertex Palace and no product result was produced. The selector inspected repository history internally up to the rand repository, then a promisor-object fetch failed during a GitHub DNS outage. The unexpected exception was printed but the original selector did not preserve a create-only target manifest. This file preserves that failed attempt before any harness amendment.

execution.error: fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/rust-random/rand.git/': Could not resolve host: github.com; fatal: could not fetch 862f2b70b33589295575711da34299d3a0bf3ece from promisor remote

rootCause.environment: GitHub DNS resolution failed during a lazy promisor-object fetch.
rootCause.harness: The selector used --filter=blob:none, allowing inspection to depend on later network fetches, and did not convert an unexpected inspection exception into preserved machine evidence.

allowedChanges: fetch complete objects for the frozen shallow history instead of using a promisor clone
capture per-repository inspection errors and advance only by the frozen family order
preserve an unexpected selection failure as create-only machine evidence
